open: Pushed and merged (Nov 1 2026): `claude/urgent-builds` reached main through `2a057cc4` once the host had git credentials; the `blocked:push` banner alert no longer applies. Wrap-up step s12 closed by the Leftovers session (`_claude/builds/reports/leftovers.md`).

The old pages (Build manager, Pending builds, Build queue, Fable rebuilds, Tracker) still exist; they now read the same store, so they can't drift, but folding their UIs into the Builds page and removing them is the follow-up. Duplicate-view candidates from the audit: build-manager, pending (core view), build-queue (core view), fable-rebuilds, feature-matrix (reads pending/queue directly), changes-grid vs codebase-changes, main-build-status vs push-banner.

"Divide further" proposes parts by splitting the step's text; a Claude-driven split (axf.llm@1) isn't wired. "Open the target live with focus highlight" and the toolbar-asset right-click editor (4c) are not built.
Versioning is the store's own journal; writes don't go through `axhub.memory_write`, so axHub's memory_history only sees them via claude-sync.
Model rule: schema + migration design would be Fable; Brett's brief pinned this whole build to Opus.
`output-recorder/test.mts` fails on untouched main too (extension-less import under `--experimental-strip-types`).
Hub path oddity: the spec lives at `/projects/projects/amberx-axf/...` (nested), so `axhub.memory_read` for it 404s.
claude-sync still holds 6 shared files (both sides changed); every one of them is now an export of the store, so either copy is safe, but Brett picks (`claude-sync resolve <id> --keep local|hub`).
During testing, `docker inspect` printed the console container's `AXF_WALL_SECRET` into this session's local log (not committed anywhere). Rotating it is advised.
